snippet.title: Revenant of Tsushima 津島・魂鬼 | Official Teaser Trailer 2 (2026)
snippet.description:
⛩️ **Revenant of Tsushima (津島・魂鬼)** is a first-person Japanese folk horror adventure developed in Unreal Engine 5 by Aurora Studio, an independent game studio based in Hong Kong.

👻 **The Windows demo is available now!**

Step into a haunting journey through Edo-period Japan, where forgotten shrines, abandoned post towns, and restless spirits conceal mysteries waiting to be uncovered.

Follow Tsushima Mewa, a shrine maiden drawn into a supernatural world inspired by Japanese folklore, spiritual traditions, and the legends of the historic Tōkaidō.

Explore atmospheric environments, investigate supernatural disturbances, and uncover the secrets hidden between the worlds of the living and the dead.

Rather than relying solely on traditional combat, Revenant of Tsushima focuses on exploration, atmosphere, spiritual encounters, and Japanese folklore.

**🎮 PLAY THE WINDOWS DEMO**

Experience an early playable version of Revenant of Tsushima on itch.io:

https://shikosama.itch.io/revenant-of-tsushima

**🌐 OFFICIAL WEBSITE**

Discover more about the game, its characters, and the world of Revenant of Tsushima:

https://revenant-tsushima.aurora-studio.org/

**ABOUT THE GAME**

- Title: Revenant of Tsushima (津島・魂鬼)
- Developer: Aurora Studio
- Genre: Japanese Folk Horror / First-Person Adventure
- Game Engine: Unreal Engine 5
- Setting: Edo-period Japan / Tōkaidō
- Platform: Windows (Demo)
- Development Status: In Development

**ABOUT AURORA STUDIO**

Aurora Studio is an independent game development studio based in Hong Kong, creating interactive experiences inspired by Japanese culture, atmospheric storytelling, and immersive virtual environments.

Studio Website: https://www.aurora-studio.org/

🎬 This video features footage from an in-development version of the game. Visuals and gameplay elements may change during development.

💬 Which Japanese folklore spirit or yokai would you like to encounter in the game? Share your thoughts in the comments!

#RevenantOfTsushima #JapaneseHorror #IndieGame
